claims.quote: The Colombian tetra, Hyphessobrycon columbianus, is a characid that appears to be known only from the Río Acandí in Chocó, northern Colombia.
The first specimens arrived in Germany in 1995, caught in a tributary of the Rio Acanti, Colombia.

regions.name: Río Acandí
regions.quote: Appears to be known only from the Río Acandí in Chocó Department, northern Colombia, close to the border with Panama.
